checks.name: Apache web server
checks.solution:
Run: sudo systemctl start apache2
If it fails to start: sudo journalctl -xe | grep apache

checks.name: PHP info page
checks.solution:
Confirm phpinfo.php exists in /var/www/html/. If missing, re-run the phpinfo.php creation step in piClinicVMSetup.sh.
Note: remove phpinfo.php before deploying to production.
If the file exists but returns 404: sudo a2enmod php8.3 && sudo systemctl restart apache2

checks.name: PHP version
checks.solution:
PHP 8.2 or later is required. Install via:
  sudo apt-get install -y libapache2-mod-php php-common php-mysql
Or use the ondrej/php PPA to install a specific version.

checks.name: MySQL connectivity
checks.solution:
If MySQL is not running: sudo systemctl start mysql
If authentication fails, check the password you set in STEP 6 of piClinicVMSetup.sh.
If the admin user does not exist, re-run the DB user creation step.

checks.name: Composer
checks.solution:
Install Composer per STEP 7 of piClinicVMSetup.sh:
  php -r "copy('https://getcomposer.org/installer', 'composer-setup.php');"
  sudo php composer-setup.php --install-dir=/usr/local/bin --filename=composer

checks.name: Node.js version
checks.solution:
Node.js 18 or later is required. Install via NodeSource per STEP 8 of piClinicVMSetup.sh:
  curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_20.x | sudo -E bash -
  sudo apt-get install -y nodejs

checks.name: npm
checks.solution:
npm is normally installed with Node. Run: sudo apt install npm
Or reinstall Node via NodeSource per STEP 8 of piClinicVMSetup.sh.

checks.name: PHPUnit
checks.solution:
Install PHPUnit 12.x globally (PHP 8.3 compatible):
  sudo wget -O /usr/local/bin/phpunit https://phar.phpunit.de/phpunit-12.phar
  sudo chmod +x /usr/local/bin/phpunit
Or install per-project: composer require --dev phpunit/phpunit:^12

checks.name: Git branch
checks.solution:
If the branch is missing: git fetch origin && git checkout react-refactor
If the repo is not present, re-clone per STEP 10 of piClinicVMSetup.sh:
  git clone -b react-refactor https://github.com/rbwatson/piClinic piClinic

checks.name: piClinic app directories
checks.solution:
Create the application directories per STEP 13 of piClinicVMSetup.sh:
  sudo mkdir -p /var/local/piclinic/image /var/local/piclinic/deleted /var/local/piclinic/downloads
  sudo mkdir -p /var/log/piclinic
  sudo chown -R www-data:www-data /var/local/piclinic /var/log/piclinic
  sudo chmod -R 750 /var/local/piclinic /var/log/piclinic
